name: Sue Lines I will now deal with the Aged Care (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2024. The question is that the bill be now read a second time. Question agreed to. Bill read a second time. I will now deal with the Committee of the Whole amendment circulated by the opposition. The question is that the opposition amendment on sheet 3214 be agreed to. _Opposition's circulated amendment—_ (1) Schedule 2, item 65, page 60 (line 3), omit "may", substitute "must".
